name: Personalized Beer Bottle Opener With Cap Catcher
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and metal, offering a sturdy, practical, and decorative wall-mounted design.
    - Made from 5mm thick wood, providing strong structure and long-lasting durability for everyday use.
    - Includes a durable metal bottle opener mounted securely on the front for quick and convenient cap removal.
    - Comes with screws and wall anchors for stable wall installation.
    - Built with an integrated cap catcher box to help collect bottle caps neatly after opening.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Wall mounting panel height:  12 in ~ 30.48 cm
    - Bottom catcher box:
            +) Width: 3 in ~ 7.62 cm
            +) Depth: 5 in ~ 12.7 cm
            +) Height: 3 in ~ 7.62 cm
    - Bottle opener size:
            +) Width: 6.2 cm
            +) Height: 7.9 cm
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - All wooden panels support double-side printing.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a wall-mounted bottle opener and a cap catcher storage box.
    - Designed for opening beer bottles quickly and conveniently while collecting caps in the bottom box.
    - Suitable for home bars, kitchens, patios, garages, game rooms, man caves, and party spaces.
    - Easy to mount on the wall using the included screws and anchors.
    - Helps keep bottle caps contained neatly while also serving as a decorative personalized sign.
    - Perfect for daily use, home entertaining, and gift display.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and practical personalized gift for dads, husbands, boyfriends, grandpas, brothers, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, housewarming gifts, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for beer lovers, home bar owners, and anyone who enjoys personalized rustic décor.
    - A thoughtful gift that combines decoration, convenience, and everyday function.
    - Great for kitchens, bars, entertainment areas, patios, and man cave décor.
    - Adds a unique, useful, and memorable touch to any home space🍺

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xPersonalized Beer Bottle Opener With Cap Catcher

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
